code: dbench/benchmark_v04/labels.py (sha256 of the file recorded below)
units: study s (test), target t (40 per study, dbench.harness.dev_metric.choose_targets, seed 20261027, saved to targets.json), 10 patient-grouped splits per target (3 query patients drawn by sha-seeded rng from (study,target,split), all others support)
pool: singles = candidate columns present in every split's episode (genes subsampled to 256 per episode with a seed fixed per (study,target); four spatial versions: own, nbr6, nbr18, contrast; target's own variable and proxy columns excluded by the episode builder); pairs = 2,000 pairs drawn uniformly without replacement from the singles, seeded by sha(study,target)
relation_family: v03_rff (relation_v03.fit_sets), fixed hyperparameters of the freeze; B_known strict exclusions; B_decomp = best proper-subset decomposition chosen on support gain
gain: G = sum over the 3 query patients of per-patient gain numerators / sum of SST (core.score_sets), fitted on support
interval: patient bootstrap, 2,000 replicates over the 3 query patients; lower bounds at 95% (2.5th pct), 90% (5th), 99% (0.5th)
null: patient-permuted target (core.null_task kind=patient), 5 draws per split, the same sets scored under each baseline; p95 over the pooled (set x draw) null gains, separately for singles and pairs and for each baseline
binary_label: 1 iff lower bound(level) > 0 and G > null p95 of that (split, size class, baseline); primary level 95, primary baseline known; B_nuis and B_decomp (pairs only) as sweeps
gam_family: pyGAM LinearGAM (spline terms for singles, tensor term for pairs) on a fixed seeded subsample of 10 targets per study at all 10 splits, 95% level only, null threshold from the same patient-permuted draws; full 40 targets if the pilot shows <= 1 day per study; stated in every table using it
glial_extension: bknown_glial_extension_v01 for brain cohorts (glioma): proxy = mean own-spot log1p-CPM of GFAP, AQP4, S100B, NDRG2, GJA1, CST3, NTRK2 present in the panel, added to B_known, computed without any proxy gene appearing in the set's variables or the target
prevalence: reported per study, per size class, per baseline and level (tables.py)
stored: raw G, gsup, lower bounds and null p95 per (target, split, size class, baseline); labels are derived, not stored
amendment_1: 2026-10-27 (coordinator): targets are frozen STATE scores only (spec 2.1): RNA-only residual programmes + Gavish/Hallmark programme scores + morphology centre similarities where H&E exists; 40 sampled uniformly (seed 20261027) from the eligible set, all if fewer; gene targets excluded (supplementary sweep only if time allows). Supersedes the choose_targets rule of the first label run, which was stopped before any label was cached for use (outputs kept in labels_superseded_gene_targets/).
amendment_2: 2026-10-27 (coordinator-approved, before any label derived): the binary B_decomp label (pairs) additionally requires the full pair's own held-out gain over B_known to be positive (G_known > 0 on the query patients): the registered G_HO definition, full model held-out R^2 > 0 (Methods 5.7). Raw G is stored for every variant, so the unguarded B_decomp label is reported beside it; B_known stays primary. Diagnostic column derived from stored arrays: comparator failure rate = share of pool pairs per (target, split) with (G_nuis - G_decomp) < -1, i.e. the best-decomposition comparator's query R^2 below -1 (instrument finding: heavy-tailed query features break the additive comparator).
amendment_3: 2026-10-27 (coordinator; declared before the slow-method probe was read): (a) at Q = 3 query patients the 95% and 99% lower bounds coincide (the patient bootstrap over 3 patients has 10 distinct compositions), so 'lower bound at 95% > 0' is equivalent to 'all three query patients have positive gain'; Q stays 3 and the 90% level is the only strictness sensitivity. (b) Slow baselines (EBM, GBM-SHAP, GBM-H, RuleFit, stability selection, NID, MISTy, iRF, knockoffs, TabDistill) run on a fixed seeded subset of 3 of the 10 splits per target (tables.slow_subset, seed sha(study,target)); ours and random are evaluated on the same subset for every paired difference involving a slow method; fast methods keep all 10 splits; a slow method that fits all 10 splits within its share of a day is run in full and stated. (c) AP lift is read beside AP everywhere.
